This product is supplied without battery and charger. 18V battery required (sold separately, see product code 853FJ).

High performance angle grinder incorporating a Powerstate brushless motor, which delivers maximum power and durability in all applications. RapidStop technology which can stop a fast disc brake in less than 2 seconds. Features a 115mm keyless guard, providing ideal cutting capacity and fast guard adjustment without the need for a spanner.
b: Does Not Include Battery or Charger
